'''Avan Beruss''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] who served in [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] during the early days of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Your father was an Imperial Senator and a friend of Bail Organa, wasn't he?"<br />"Yes, sir. I wanted to join the rebellion with Leia, but my father had other ideas.|[[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] and Beruss, the former reviewing Beruss's history|<ref name="XRS21" />}}
The son of [[Illodia]]n [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Doman Beruss (Illodian)|Doman Beruss]] and great nephew of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] Senator [[Doman Beruss (Corellian)|Doman Beruss]], the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] Avan Beruss was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] into the privilege of a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Clan Beruss|family]], befriending other similarly blessed [[Youngling/Legends|children]] like [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]].

[[File:Avan.jpg|thumb|left|165px|Avan on Ciutric IV]]
During his time at the [[Illodian Officers' Academy]], Beruss developed skills as a [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]]. After graduating with honors, Beruss was slated to represent Illodia in the [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] [[Imperial Games]] as a sharpshooter, until they were cancelled due to [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]].

While his [[Parent/Legends|father]] encouraged Beruss to join the Illodian defense force, he instead chose to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], ignoring his father's fears of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] reprisal against his homeworld.

Beruss was offered a position in the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] shortly before the [[Battle of Brentaal IV (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Brentaal IV]], c. [[4 ABY/Legends|4.75 ABY]], despite having only completed two combat missions prior. During his tenure with the Rogues, he served as [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel's]] [[Wingmate/Legends|wingman]] and fell in love with fellow pilot [[Feylis Ardele]].
